d:
Karma strikes an enemy with his battleaxe, dealing [[400%]]{atk} damage and stunning the target for [[2.5]]s. After [[1]]s, an explosion erupts within 1 tile of the impact tile, dealing [[400%]]{atk} damage plus extra damage equal to [[40%]] of the total healing Karma has received since this skill was last cast. The extra damage cannot exceed [[500%]]{atk}.
Karma recovers [[10%]]{hp} HP for each non-summoned enemy hit by the explosion. For each non-summoned enemy defeated during the battle, this healing increases by that same amount.
Increases the explosion's base damage to [[420%]]{atk} and the HP restored per enemy hit to [[11%]] of his max HP.
Increases the explosion's base damage to [[440%]]{atk} and the HP restored per enemy hit to [[12%]] of his max HP.
Increases the explosion's base damage to [[460%]]{atk} and the HP restored per enemy hit to [[13%]] of his max HP.
Increases the explosion's base damage to [[500%]]{atk} and the HP restored per enemy hit to [[15%]] of his max HP.

Kar drenches himself in special potions, leaving behind a pool with a 1-tile radius at his location that lasts for [[6]]s. The pool deals [[100%]]{atk} damage every second to enemies within it and restores [[140%]]{atk} HP to Karma every second. At the same time, Mar swings his battleaxe to deal [[300%]]{atk} damage to nearby enemies.
Increases HP restored per second to [[160%]]{atk}.
Increases HP restored per second to [[180%]]{atk}.
Increases HP restored per second to [[200%]]{atk}.

Kar downs a potion, restoring [[20%]] of his max HP every second for [[5]]s. Mar then unleashes a rapid 3-hit axe flurry against enemies in a 1-tile frontal arc, dealing [[140%]]{atk} damage per hit. The final hit also knocks targets down for [[2]]s.
Increases the damage of each axe strike to [[160%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage of each axe strike to [[180%]]{atk}.
Increases the damage of each axe strike to [[200%]]{atk}.
Karma gains [[11]] Vitality during battle.
Karma gains [[15]] Vitality during battle.
Karma gains [[19]] Vitality during battle.

Karma grows stronger from the healing he receives. For every [[35%]] of his initial max HP he receives in healing, his max HP increases by [[40%]] (up to [[200%]]) and he grows slightly larger in size. At max stacks, Karma also gains [[60%]] Phys & Magic DEF and [[50]] Resilience, and the damage range of Unfettered Carnage, Toxic Mosh Pit, and Bottled Bloodlust is increased by 1 tile.
Increases the max HP gained each time to [[45%]] and the max HP increase limit to [[225%]]. At max stacks, Karma gains an extra [[70%]] Phys & Magic DEF.

Once the max HP increase from this skill reaches its limit, Karma permanently gains [[steadfast|steadfast]]. In addition, his axe strikes from Toxic Mosh Pit and Bottled Bloodlust deal [[15%]]{hp} extra magic damage on hit.
Increases the max HP gained each time to [[50%]] and the max HP increase limit to [[250%]]. At max stacks, Karma gains [[80%]] Phys & Magic DEF.

r.d: In Rivalry Mode, when HP drops below [[60%]], reduces damage taken by [[15%]] and recovers [[3%]] of lost HP per second for [[8]]s. Triggers up to once every [[20]]s.
Refine 4: In Rivalry Mode, increases 15 Vitality, 10 Crit Resist.

d: While affected by his own potions, Karma takes [[50%]] less damage. This effect cannot stack.
